title: Profile & Certificate Vault
note: url is overridden automatically by the SITE_URL env var. GitHub Actions sets it from the live Pages URL, so this value only affects local builds.
adsenseNote: Paste your AdSense publisher id (ca-pub-…) into adsenseClient and the three ad-unit ids to switch the reserved rails from placeholders to live units. Left empty, the layout still reserves the space, so turning ads on later shifts nothing.
